payload.rationale: Latent world model for robotic/driving action selection; no connection to B-rep encoding, program synthesis, or structural validity of generated code.
Argument component detection via instruction-tuned LLMs is a pure NLP task with no bridge to CAD/program-synthesis care areas.
Graph-based registration is applied to diffusion MRI motion correction, not to B-rep face graphs or program generation; the graph mechanism doesn't transfer.
Counterfactual chest X-ray generation via foundation-model specialisation; medical imaging application with no plausible bridge.

Theoretical treatment of OOD generalization/exactness (Tensor Logic) touches distribution-shift themes abstractly, but offers no concrete, transferable mechanism for geometric/program generation and no empirical bridge to CAD or graph decoders.
Analysis of medical-image tokenizers for latent diffusion; unrelated to B-rep/program representation.
Robot simulation infrastructure via autoregressive diffusion over joint trajectories; embodied-AI application with no bearing on hex-meshing program generation.

Junction-tree LP formulation and message passing for optimal classification trees; a structured/graph optimization technique but applied to a classification task with no transfer to program synthesis or CAD.
Wearable sensing for agitation detection in autistic youth; no bridge to any care area.
Visuo-tactile world-action model for dexterous manipulation; robotics application, no plausible bridge to B-rep/program generation.
GNN framework for electricity-load forecasting; graph neural nets but applied to a forecasting task unrelated to pointer/copy mechanisms over B-rep graphs.
Tree-structured speculative decoding tuned to DeepSeek-V4's attention; an LLM-inference efficiency technique, not structured/schema-constrained generation for program validity.

Process-level evaluation methodology for self-evolving agents; adjacent in spirit to self-improvement flywheels but is an evaluation framework for agent memories/skills, not a rejection-sampled SFT or verifier-in-the-loop training mechanism we could reuse.
Extreme low-bit weight quantization for VLMs; pure inference-efficiency work, no bridge to structural validity or CAD generation.

Stress-tests feed-forward 3D reconstruction under viewpoint/distribution shift, conceptually adjacent to domain-gap concerns, but it's a diagnostic study on image-based reconstruction with no new mechanism or B-rep/graph-model relevance; our rotation-robustness line is explicitly closed and this isn't a genuinely new mechanism.
Privacy-preserving smart-glasses video redaction; no bridge to any care area.

Agentic VLM-in-the-loop shape/pose refinement for video tracking of articulated objects; superficially resembles verifier-in-the-loop iteration but is inference-time analysis-by-synthesis for tracking, not training-time rejection sampling against a frozen verifier, and the domain (video tracking) doesn't transfer to B-rep/program generation.
Domain-specific offline multi-object tracking for windsurfing video; no bridge to any care area.

SE(3) potential fields for image-based grasp trajectory planning; pose/SE(3) terminology but concerns motion planning, not rotation-invariant/equivariant encoders for set/graph inputs, and no B-rep or program-synthesis relevance.
Unified embodied-cognition VLM for robotics/driving/navigation; no plausible bridge to CAD/program generation.
Visuomotor RL for robotic tree pruning; unrelated application domain.
Video world model with 3D-aware memory for scene exploration; generative video modeling, no bridge to B-rep/program synthesis.
FPGA architecture for speculative-decoding inference acceleration; hardware/systems work with no bearing on structural validity of generated programs.
Geometric analysis of speaker-embedding hyperspheres for voice conversion; unrelated audio application.
Multi-view transformer for 3D human pose estimation; unrelated application, no transferable mechanism to B-rep/pointer-network decoding.
Tactile-augmented human demonstration collection for dexterous manipulation policies; robotics data-collection method, no bridge to program synthesis or CAD.
